decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of high-end hiking packs, casual mesh backpacks, tactical bags, and sling-style crossbody bags. The feed contained several items that were not actually backpacks (chairs, tarps, cleaning kits), which limited the effective selection. I prioritized products with high ratings and substantial review counts. The adidas Hermosa Mesh Backpack (prod_backpacks_128) stood out due to its 4.7-star rating and its reputation for durability in a school or daily setting. While the NICGID sling (prod_backpacks_159) was a close second for portability, the adidas offered better overall utility for the price.
